title: Human-Data Interaction, Exploration, and Visualization Systems in the AI Era: Challenges and Opportunities
abstract: arXiv:2603.05542v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: The rapid advancement of AI is transforming human-centered systems, with profound implications for human-AI interaction, human-data interaction, and visual analytics. In the AI era, data analysis increasingly involves large-scale, heterogeneous, and multimodal data that is predominantly unstructured, as well as foundation models such as LLMs and VLMs, which introduce additional uncertainty into analytical processes. These shifts expose persistent challenges for human-data interactive systems, including perceptually misaligned latency, scalability constraints, limitations of existing interaction and exploration paradigms, and growing uncertainty regarding the reliability and interpretability of AI-generated insights. translated_title: AI时代的人-数据交互、探索与可视化系统：挑战与机遇
translated_abstract: arXiv:2603.05542v2 公告类型： replace-cross 摘要：人工智能的快速发展正在变革以人为中心的系统，对人机交互、人-数据交互以及可视分析产生了深远影响。在AI时代，数据分析日益涉及大规模、异构且以非结构化为主的多模态数据，以及大语言模型（LLM）和视觉语言模型（VLM）等基础模型，这些模型为分析过程引入了额外的不确定性。这些变化暴露了人-数据交互系统长期存在的挑战，包括感知不匹配的延迟、可扩展性限制、现有交互与探索范式的局限性，以及AI生成洞察在可靠性与可解释性方面日益增长的不确定性。应对这些挑战需要超越传统的效率与可扩展性指标，重新定义人类与机器在分析工作流中的角色，并将认知、感知等因素纳入考量……
tldr: 该论文系统分析了AI时代大规模多模态数据与基础模型不确定性对人-数据交互与可视化系统带来的延迟、可扩展性、交互范式和可信度等核心挑战，并提出需要重新定义人机角色、突破传统效率指标来构建新一代交互与可视分析系统。
en_tdlr: This paper identifies how AI-era large-scale multimodal data and foundation model uncertainty expose key challenges in human-data interaction and visualization systems—including latency misalignment, scalability limits, and interpretability—and argues for redefining human-machine roles beyond conventional efficiency metrics.
